Abilities with no good BG3 equivalent yet are listed in 'leftOut' with their costs.

jobLevels.note: Total JP earned for job levels 2-8. TIC uses the WotL table (PS1 US was lower, e.g. Lv3 350, Lv4 550).

jpFormula.enhancedBonus: TIC Enhanced: +30% JP from the unit's own actions, applied after the formula, not to spillover or proposition JP
jpFormula.spillover: allies on the field get 1/4 of the JP an ally earns, in that ally's job, before JP Boost; in TIC also into jobs they have not unlocked
jpFormula.uncertain: fan analysis suggests the TIC constant may be 16 instead of 8

jobs.name: Mime

mastery.description: +1 to all saving throws. (The Mime has no abilities to learn: it is mastered at job level 8.)

jobs.description: Mimics the party. Echo: at the start of your turn in a fight you get a copy of the last job ability an ally used since your previous turn, usable once this turn and free of its cooldown. Concentration (+2 to weapon attack rolls), Brawler (stronger unarmed strikes) and Beastmaster (allied beasts and summons within 6 m get +1 to attack rolls and damage) are always on.

jobs.name: Dark Knight
jobs.description: A knight who wields darkness (War of the Lions). Fell Sword drains HP and spell slots from foes and trades your own HP for crushing blows around you. A late job: master Knight and Black Mage, reach level 8 as Dragoon, Samurai, Ninja and Geomancer, and defeat 20 enemies.

mastery.description: +1 AC. (The Onion Knight has no abilities to learn: it is mastered at job level 8.)

jobs.description: War of the Lions' blank-slate knight. It has no abilities, and while it is your job your secondary, reaction and passive slots rest too (FFT's rule). In return it uses every weapon, armour and shield and grows with its job level: at Lv5 +1 AC and +1 to attack rolls, at Lv8 +2 to every ability score, +2 AC and +2 to attack rolls.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.description: Spin and strike every enemy within 2 m: an unarmed attack roll against each, 1d8 + your unarmed attack modifier bludgeoning on a hit. FFT also hits allies; here only enemies.
abilities.fft: Strikes all adjacent units.

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.description: Two quick unarmed strikes at a creature in melee range: each hit deals 1d6 + your unarmed attack modifier bludgeoning.
abilities.fft: Strikes many times in quick succession.

abilities.name: Aurablast

abilities.fft: Attacks a distant unit with martial spirit.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: A shockwave tears through the ground in a 12 m line: creatures in it make a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC), taking 3d8 bludgeoning and falling prone on a failure, half damage on a success. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Earth damage to units in a straight line.

abilities.name: Doom Fist
abilities.description: Unarmed strike at a pressure point: on a hit, the creature makes a Constitution save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or is Doomed, and dies when Doom runs out after 3 turns. Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Purification
abilities.description: You and allies within 3 m are cured of blindness, poison, disease, paralysis, silence, sleep, confusion, fear and charm. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Removes status ailments from oneself and adjacent units.

abilities.name: Chakra
abilities.description: You and allies within 3 m regain 2d6 + your unarmed attack modifier hit points and one level 1 spell slot (FFT restores MP). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Restores HP and MP to oneself and adjacent units.

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: With a battle cry, bring a dead ally in melee range back to life with 2d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Revives an adjacent KO'd unit.

abilities.name: Critical: Recover HP
abilities.description: When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you regain half your maximum hit points. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Fully restores HP when damaged into critical condition.

abilities.name: Counter
abilities.description: Reaction: when an enemy hits you with a melee attack, strike back with your weapon or fists.
abilities.fft: Strikes back with Attack when hit by a physical attack.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: Reaction: when an enemy moves into your melee reach, attack it first (like Polearm Master, with any weapon or fists). BG3 cannot cancel the enemy's own attack.

abilities.name: Brawler
abilities.description: Unarmed strikes get +1 to attack rolls and deal 1d6 more damage. Always on while Monk is your job.
abilities.fft: More powerful bare-handed attacks, even if not a monk.

abilities.name: Lifefont
abilities.description: When you move, regain 1d6 hit points. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Recovers HP upon moving.

abilities.description: Melee attack roll; on a hit you pocket gold: 10 times the creature's level. Each creature can be robbed of gold once.
abilities.fft: Pilfers gil from an adjacent foe.

abilities.name: Steal Heart
abilities.description: A creature up to 9 m away makes a Wisdom save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or is Charmed for 2 turns: it can't harm you. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Charmed on a distant foe.

abilities.fft: Purloins an adjacent foe's equipped headwear.

abilities.name: Steal Armor

abilities.fft: Purloins an adjacent foe's equipped combat garb.

abilities.name: Steal Shield
abilities.description: Melee attack roll; on a hit you take the enemy's shield into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen.
abilities.fft: Purloins an adjacent foe's equipped shield.

abilities.name: Steal Weapon
abilities.description: Melee attack roll; on a hit you take the enemy's main weapon (melee first, otherwise ranged) into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Poach
abilities.description: When a beast or monster (not a humanoid) you hit with a weapon this turn dies, you take a trophy worth 5 times its level in gold.
abilities.fft: Claims a creature's carcass when defeating it with Attack.

abilities.name: Movement +2
abilities.description: +6 m movement speed.
abilities.fft: Increases movement by 2.

abilities.name: Jump +2
abilities.description: Jump 6 m farther.
abilities.fft: Increases jump by 2.

abilities.name: Haste
abilities.description: An ally within 18 m is Hasted for 3 turns (BG3's Haste: an extra action, +2 AC, more movement, then a turn of lethargy). No concentration. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Grants Haste to a distant unit.

abilities.name: Hasteja
abilities.description: Every ally within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away is Hasted for 3 turns (as Haste). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Grants Haste to units in an area.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.description: An enemy within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Slowed for 3 turns (BG3's Slow: -2 AC and Dexterity saves, half movement, no reactions; it repeats the save each turn). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Slow on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Slowja
abilities.description: Every enemy within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away makes a Wisdom save or is Slowed for 3 turns (as Slow). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Slow on units in an area.

abilities.name: Stop
abilities.description: An enemy within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Stopped for 2 turns: it can't move or act, and melee hits on it are critical (it repeats the save each turn). Bosses are immune. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Stop on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Immobilize
abilities.description: An enemy within 18 m makes a Strength save or can't move for 2 turns (it can still act; it repeats the save each turn).
abilities.fft: Inflicts Immobilize on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Float
abilities.description: An ally within 18 m floats for 3 turns: it can't be knocked prone and ignores difficult terrain.
abilities.fft: Grants Float to a distant unit.

abilities.name: Reflect
abilities.description: An ally within 18 m is shielded for 3 turns: it takes half damage from spells, and a caster whose spell damages it takes 2d6 force damage. BG3 cannot bounce the spell itself. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Grants Reflect: magick bounces back.

abilities.name: Quick
abilities.description: Another ally within 18 m gets an extra action on its next turn (BG3 cannot give it a turn right away). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: The target's next turn comes immediately.

abilities.name: Gravity
abilities.description: Creatures within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away make a Constitution save or lose a quarter of their maximum hit points (force). Bosses are immune. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Reduces HP by a small proportion of the maximum.

abilities.name: Graviga
abilities.description: Creatures within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away make a Constitution save or lose half of their maximum hit points (force). Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Reduces HP by a large proportion of the maximum.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.description: A meteor smashes into a point up to 18 m away: creatures within 5 m take 5d8 bludgeoning and 5d8 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: An enormous meteor smites distant units.

abilities.name: Critical: Quick
abilities.description: When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you get an extra action on your next turn. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: When critical, the unit's next turn comes immediately.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.description: Reaction: when you would take damage, spend a level 1 spell slot to reduce it by 3d8 (FFT takes the damage from MP).
abilities.fft: Damage reduces MP instead of HP.

abilities.name: Swiftspell
abilities.description: +2 to initiative, and in each fight the first spell you cast that costs an action costs a bonus action instead (FFT casts faster).
abilities.fft: Reduces the time needed to cast magick.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Bonus action, once per turn: teleport to a spot you can see up to 9 m away (Misty Step without a spell slot).
abilities.fft: Warps instantly to destination tiles.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description: You always float: you can't be knocked prone and you ignore difficult terrain.
abilities.fft: Permanent Float in battle.

abilities.name: Umbra
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Blinded for 2 turns (it repeats the save each turn).
abilities.fft: Inflicts Blindness on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Empowerment
abilities.description: Drain a creature within 18 m: it makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d10 psychic damage, and you regain a level 1 spell slot (FFT absorbs MP). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Absorbs MP from a distant unit.

abilities.name: Invigoration
abilities.description: Ranged spell attack against a creature within 18 m: 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain half the damage dealt. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Absorbs HP from a distant unit.

abilities.name: Belief
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m gains Faith for 3 turns: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, but -2 to saving throws (strengthen an ally's magic, or soften an enemy). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Grants Faith status.

abilities.name: Disbelief
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or becomes an Atheist for 2 turns: it can't cast spells and has advantage on saving throws against spells. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Atheist.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or turns Undead for 3 turns: it can't regain hit points and is vulnerable to radiant damage. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Undead status.

abilities.name: Quiescence
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Silenced for 2 turns (no spells with a verbal component). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Silence on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Fervor
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or goes Berserk for 2 turns: it can't cast spells, deals 2 more damage and has -2 AC. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Berserk.

abilities.name: Trepidation
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened of you for 2 turns (FFT lowers Bravery).
abilities.fft: Reduces a unit's Bravery for the battle.

abilities.name: Delirium
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Confused for 2 turns (it repeats the save each turn). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Confusion.

abilities.name: Harmony
abilities.description: Strip a creature within 18 m of its blessings: Haste, Bless, Aid, Heroism, Shield of Faith, Barkskin, Stoneskin, Blur, Protection from Evil and Good, Freedom of Movement, Sanctuary, Longstrider, Invisibility, and this mod's Protect, Shell, Regen, Focus, Faith, Reflect, Float and Quick. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Removes beneficial status effects.

abilities.name: Hesitation
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Disabled for 1 turn: no actions or bonus actions (it can still move).
abilities.fft: Inflicts Disable on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Repose
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or falls Asleep for 2 turns (it wakes when damaged). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Sleep on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Induration
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Petrified for 2 turns (incapacitated, resistant to all damage). Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Stone.

abilities.name: Absorb MP
abilities.description: When a spell damages you, you regain a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Recovers MP when hit by magick.

abilities.name: Defense Boost
abilities.description: +1 AC.
abilities.fft: Increases defense against physical attacks.

abilities.name: Ignore Weather
abilities.description: You ignore difficult terrain (mud, water, ice, webs).
abilities.fft: Moves unimpeded through marshes, swamps and poisonous fens.

abilities.name: Manafont
abilities.description: When you move, you regain a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Recovers MP upon moving.

abilities.name: Sinkhole
abilities.description: Only on plain ground (no surface under you). Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Immobilized for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Soil or wasteland underfoot: damage at range, may Immobilize.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Only while you stand in water or are Wet (rain counts). Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11) and are Wet; it can't be dodged. One that fails a Strength save has a 1 in 4 chance of being turned into a critter for 1 turn (Toad; in BG3 a sheep).
abilities.fft: Water underfoot: water damage at range, may inflict Toad.

abilities.name: Tanglevine
abilities.description: Only while you stand in vines, overgrowth or webs. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 piercing damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 10 chance of being Stopped for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Grass, underbrush or vines underfoot: damage at range, may inflict Stop.

abilities.name: Contortion
abilities.description: Only in shadow or darkness. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 10 chance of being turned to Stone for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Gravel, flagstone, stone walls or gravestones underfoot: damage at range, may petrify.

abilities.name: Tremor
abilities.description: Only on plain ground (no surface under you). Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Confused for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Stone outcrops or basalt underfoot: earth damage at range, may Confuse.

abilities.name: Wind Slash
abilities.description: Only in sunlight. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 slashing damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Disabled (no actions) for 1 turn.
abilities.fft: Trees, moss, bridges or furniture underfoot: wind damage at range, may Disable.

abilities.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
abilities.description: Only in shadow or darkness, or while you stand in grease, oil or alcohol. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 fire damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Wisdom save has a 1 in 4 chance of falling Asleep for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Wooden floors, carpets or decks underfoot: fire damage at range, may inflict Sleep.

abilities.name: Quicksand
abilities.description: Only while you stand in mud, blood, acid or poison. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Strength save has a 1 in 10 chance of being Doomed (dies after 3 turns; bosses are immune).
abilities.fft: Marsh, swamp or poisonous fen underfoot: water damage at range, may inflict Doom.

abilities.name: Sandstorm
abilities.description: Only in sunlight. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 slashing damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Blinded for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Sand, stalactites or salt flats underfoot: wind damage at range, may Blind.

abilities.name: Snowstorm
abilities.description: Only while you stand on ice. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 cold damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Silenced for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Snow underfoot: ice damage at range, may Silence.

abilities.name: Wind Blast
abilities.description: Only in sunlight. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 thunder damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Strength save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Slowed for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Roofs or chimneys underfoot: wind damage at range, may Slow.

abilities.name: Magma Surge
abilities.description: Only while you stand in fire or lava. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 fire damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 10 chance of being struck down at the end of its next turn (Doom 1; bosses are immune).
abilities.fft: Lava or machinery underfoot: fire damage at range, may KO outright.

abilities.name: Nature's Wrath
abilities.description: When a weapon attack hits you, the ground strikes back: the attacker takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11). Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Counters physical attacks and Geomancy with a Geomancy skill, even unlearned ones.

abilities.name: Attack Boost
abilities.description: +2 damage with weapon attacks.
abilities.fft: Increases physical attack power.

abilities.name: Ignore Terrain
abilities.description: Difficult terrain (water, mud, ice, vines, ...) doesn't slow you.
abilities.fft: Move unimpeded through rivers, lakes and other difficult terrain.

abilities.name: Lavawalking
abilities.description: Walk on lava: it doesn't set you ablaze or slow you.
abilities.fft: Move across and stop on lava.

abilities.name: Horizontal Jump +1
abilities.description: Jump: leap up to 6 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a horizontal range of 2 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Horizontal Jump +2
abilities.description: Jump: leap up to 7.5 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a horizontal range of 3 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Horizontal Jump +3
abilities.description: Jump: leap up to 9 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a horizontal range of 4 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Horizontal Jump +4
abilities.description: Jump: leap up to 12 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a horizontal range of 5 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Horizontal Jump +7
abilities.description: Jump: leap up to 18 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a horizontal range of 8 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±2
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 1d4 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 2 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±3
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 1d6 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 3 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±4
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 1d8 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 4 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±5
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 1d10 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 5 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±6
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 2d6 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 6 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±7
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 2d8 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 7 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Vertical Jump ±8
abilities.description: Your Jump lands harder: 2d10 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
abilities.fft: Grants Jump a vertical range of 8 tiles; only the highest applies.

abilities.name: Dragonheart
abilities.description: When a weapon attack damages you, you gain Death Ward (the next blow that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 instead; FFT gives Reraise). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving a physical attack, grants Reraise.

abilities.name: Equip Polearms
abilities.description: Proficiency with spears, pikes, glaives, halberds and tridents, whatever your job.
abilities.fft: Allows equipping polearms regardless of job.

abilities.name: Ignore Elevation
abilities.description: Jump 6 m farther and take no falling damage.
abilities.fft: Move to tiles of any height regardless of jump.

abilities.name: Moogle
abilities.description: Up to 4 allies within 18 m regain 2d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Restores HP to allies (Moogle Charm).

abilities.name: Shiva
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 cold damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Ice damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Ramuh
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Lightning damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Ifrit
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Fire damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Titan
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone (Dexterity save for half, no prone). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Earth damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Golem
abilities.description: You and allies within 6 m gain 15 temporary hit points (FFT's Golem blocks physical damage). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Shields allies from physical damage.

abilities.name: Carbuncle
abilities.description: You and allies within 6 m gain Reflect for 3 turns. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Grants Reflect to allies.

abilities.name: Bahamut
abilities.description: Mega Flare: enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 8d8 force damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Massive non-elemental damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Odin
abilities.description: Zantetsuken: enemies within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away take 6d10 slashing damage (Constitution save for half; FFT kills outright). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Instant death to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Leviathan
abilities.description: A tidal wave: enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 5d8 bludgeoning damage and are soaked (Wet: weak to cold and lightning; Dexterity save for half, not wet). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Water damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Salamander
abilities.description: Enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 6d8 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Fire damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Sylph
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 3d6 thunder damage and are Silenced for 2 turns (Constitution save for half, no silence). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Wind damage and Silence to enemies.

abilities.name: Faerie
abilities.description: Up to 6 allies within 18 m regain 4d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Restores HP to allies.

abilities.name: Lich
abilities.description: Enemies within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d10 necrotic damage (Constitution save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Dark damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Cyclops
abilities.description: Enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 7d10 bludgeoning damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Massive damage to enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Critical: Recover MP
abilities.description: When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you regain all your level 1 spell slots. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Fully restores MP when damaged into critical condition.

abilities.name: Halve MP
abilities.description: When you finish a short rest, you regain one level 1 and one level 2 spell slot (FFT halves MP costs).
abilities.fft: Halves the MP cost of abilities.

abilities.name: Entice
abilities.description: A foe within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or switches sides for 2 turns (4 with Tame), fighting for you on its own. Bosses are immune. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Persuades a distant foe to become an ally (it joins the party after battle).

abilities.name: Stall
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or loses its actions and bonus actions next turn (it can still move; FFT resets its CT). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Resets a distant unit's CT to zero.

abilities.name: Praise
abilities.description: An ally within 18 m is Blessed for 3 turns (+1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws; FFT raises Bravery).
abilities.fft: Increases the bravery of a distant unit.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: A foe within 18 m makes a Charisma save or is Baned for 3 turns (-1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws; FFT lowers Bravery).
abilities.fft: Reduces the bravery of a distant unit.

abilities.name: Preach
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m gains Faith for 3 turns: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, -2 to saving throws.
abilities.fft: Increases the faith of a distant unit.

abilities.name: Enlighten
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or becomes an Atheist for 2 turns: no spells, advantage on saving throws against spells.
abilities.fft: Reduces the faith of a distant unit.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Doomed: it dies when Doom runs out after 3 turns. Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Doom on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Defraud
abilities.description: A foe within 9 m makes a Wisdom save or hands over gold: 10 times its level (once per creature, shared with Steal Gil).
abilities.fft: Obtains gil from a distant foe.

abilities.name: Insult
abilities.description: A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or goes Berserk for 2 turns: no spells, 2 more damage, -2 AC. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Berserk on a distant unit.

abilities.name: Mimic Darlavon
abilities.description: A dull lecture: enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away make a Wisdom save or fall Asleep for 2 turns (they wake when damaged). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflicts Sleep on distant units.

abilities.name: Earplugs
abilities.description: Advantage on Wisdom saving throws (most talk skills and charms aim at Wisdom).
abilities.fft: Greatly increases the chance of avoiding Speechcraft.

abilities.name: Equip Guns
abilities.description: Proficiency with hand crossbows and light crossbows (BG3 has no guns), whatever your job.
abilities.fft: Allows equipping guns regardless of job.

abilities.name: Tame
abilities.description: Gives the Tame action: a beast or monster (not a humanoid) at 25% of its hit points or less makes a Wisdom save or fights for you for the rest of the fight. Bosses are immune. Once per short rest. Entice also lasts 4 turns.
abilities.fft: Forces a critically wounded creature to become an ally.

abilities.name: Beast Tongue
abilities.description: You can Speak with Animals at will. Always on while Orator is your job. (FFT: talk skills work on monsters; here they always do.)
abilities.fft: Allows Speechcraft against creatures, even if not an orator.

abilities.name: Ashura
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of you make a Dexterity save or take 1d8 slashing damage (2d8 from level 5, 3d8 from level 11).
abilities.fft: Spirit Blade: an unseen sword slashes surrounding foes.

abilities.name: Kotetsu
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of you take 3d6 necrotic damage (Constitution save for half). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Binding Darkness: howling dark spirits strike surrounding foes.

abilities.name: Bizen Osafune
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of you take 3d6 psychic damage and are Silenced for 1 turn (Wisdom save: half damage, no silence; FFT drains MP). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Verse of Oblivion: the whispering dead feed on surrounding foes' MP.

abilities.name: Murasame
abilities.description: You and allies within 3 m of you regain 2d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Rain of Wisdom: restores HP to you and surrounding allies.

abilities.name: Ame-no-Murakumo
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of you take 4d6 cold damage and are Slowed for 2 turns (Constitution save: half damage, not slowed). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Cloudsea Curse: a phantom of mist attacks surrounding foes, may Slow.

abilities.name: Kiyomori
abilities.description: You and allies within 3 m of you gain Protect (+2 AC) and Shell (advantage on saves against spells) for 3 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Purifying Breeze: Protect and Shell for you and surrounding allies.

abilities.name: Muramasa
abilities.description: Enemies within 3 m of you take 4d8 necrotic damage. On a failed Wisdom save they are Confused for 2 turns, with a 1 in 10 chance of Doom (bosses are immune); on a success they take half. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Doomed Aspirations: attacks surrounding foes, may Confuse or Doom.

abilities.name: Kiku-ichimonji
abilities.description: Enemies in a 12 m line from you take 6d8 slashing damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Sanguine Blossom: all-consuming hatred lashes out in a straight line.

abilities.name: Masamune
abilities.description: You and allies within 3 m of you gain Regen for 3 turns and Haste for 2 (an extra action, +2 AC, double movement; lethargic for a turn afterwards, as in BG3). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Ethereal Embrace: Regen and Haste for you and surrounding allies.

abilities.name: Chirijiraden
abilities.description: A ring of blue flame: enemies within 5 m of you take 8d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Raging Inferno: a band of blue flame attacks surrounding foes.

abilities.name: Bonecrusher
abilities.description: When a hit leaves you at 25% of your hit points or less, you strike back: the attacker takes 4d10 slashing damage. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: In critical condition, counters with damage based on maximum HP.

abilities.name: Shirahadori
abilities.description: When an attack hits you, use your reaction to take half damage (like Uncanny Dodge; switch it on or off on your passives bar).
abilities.fft: Parry physical attacks with a chance equal to Bravery.

abilities.name: Equip Katana
abilities.description: Proficiency with longswords and scimitars (BG3 has no katanas), whatever your job.
abilities.fft: Allows equipping katana regardless of job.

abilities.name: Doublehand
abilities.description: +2 damage with versatile weapons (longswords, spears, quarterstaffs, ...) held in both hands.
abilities.fft: Wield a one-handed weapon with both hands for greater attack power.

abilities.name: Swim
abilities.description: Deep water doesn't slow you.
abilities.fft: Swim through and stop in deep water.

abilities.name: Throw Shuriken
abilities.description: Hurl a shuriken at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 piercing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a shuriken from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Bombs
abilities.description: Hurl a bomb at a point up to 18 m away: enemies within 2 m of it take 2d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a bomb from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Daggers
abilities.description: Hurl a dagger at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 slashing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a dagger from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Swords
abilities.description: Hurl a sword at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 slashing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a sword from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Flails
abilities.description: Hurl a flail at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a flail from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Katana
abilities.description: Hurl a katana at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d10 slashing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a katana from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Ninja Blades
abilities.description: Hurl a ninja blade at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 piercing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a ninja blade from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Axes
abilities.description: Hurl an axe at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d10 slashing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws an axe from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Polearms
abilities.description: Hurl a polearm at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d10 piercing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a polearm from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Poles
abilities.description: Hurl a pole at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a pole from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Knight's Swords
abilities.description: Hurl a knight's sword at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 slashing damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a knight's sword from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Throw Books
abilities.description: Hurl a book at a creature up to 18 m away: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force damage + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher). No item is used up. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Throws a book from the inventory at a distant foe.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: When a weapon attack hits you, you turn invisible for up to 2 turns (it ends when you attack or cast). Once per combat.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving a physical attack, grants Invisibility.

abilities.name: Reflexes
abilities.description: +1 AC and advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving an attack, greatly increases parry and evasion.

abilities.name: Dual Wield
abilities.description: Fight with a weapon in each hand like a Ninja: you add your ability modifier to off-hand damage (Two-Weapon Fighting) and can dual-wield weapons that aren't light. Always on while Ninja is your job.
abilities.fft: Wield a weapon in each hand, even if not a ninja.

abilities.name: Waterwalking
abilities.description: Deep water doesn't slow you, and water never leaves you Wet.
abilities.fft: Move across and stop on the surface of water.

abilities.name: Target CT
abilities.description: Arithmeticks number: a creature's current hit points (FFT: CT, which changes every turn). Load it on the Job Board (Arithmetician job): the rule buttons then use it.
abilities.fft: Sets the target variable to CT.

abilities.name: Target Level
abilities.description: Arithmeticks number: a creature's level. Load it on the Job Board (Arithmetician job): the rule buttons then use it.
abilities.fft: Sets the target variable to Level.

abilities.name: Target EXP
abilities.description: Arithmeticks number: a creature's maximum hit points (FFT: EXP). Load it on the Job Board (Arithmetician job): the rule buttons then use it.
abilities.fft: Sets the target variable to EXP.

abilities.name: Target Elevation
abilities.description: Arithmeticks number: a creature's distance from you in whole metres (FFT: the height it stands at). Load it on the Job Board (Arithmetician job): the rule buttons then use it.
abilities.fft: Sets the target variable to Elevation.

abilities.name: Prime
abilities.description: Arithmeticks rule: instantly cast your loaded magick, free, at every creature in the fight (allies too, as in FFT) whose loaded number is a prime number (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ...). Load the magick and the number on the Job Board.
abilities.fft: Casts on units whose variable is prime.

abilities.name: Multiple of 5
abilities.description: Arithmeticks rule: instantly cast your loaded magick, free, at every creature in the fight (allies too, as in FFT) whose loaded number is a multiple of 5. Load the magick and the number on the Job Board.
abilities.fft: Casts on units whose variable is a multiple of 5.

abilities.name: Multiple of 4
abilities.description: Arithmeticks rule: instantly cast your loaded magick, free, at every creature in the fight (allies too, as in FFT) whose loaded number is a multiple of 4. Load the magick and the number on the Job Board.
abilities.fft: Casts on units whose variable is a multiple of 4.

abilities.name: Multiple of 3
abilities.description: Arithmeticks rule: instantly cast your loaded magick, free, at every creature in the fight (allies too, as in FFT) whose loaded number is a multiple of 3. Load the magick and the number on the Job Board.
abilities.fft: Casts on units whose variable is a multiple of 3.

abilities.name: Cup of Life
abilities.description: When you regain hit points, allies within 6 m of you regain 1d4 hit points. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: When HP is restored, distributes any excess among all allies.

abilities.name: Soulbind
abilities.description: When a creature damages you, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you regain 1d6 hit points. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving damage, deals half of it back and recovers that much HP.

abilities.name: EXP Boost
abilities.description: Earn 25% more experience from fights.
abilities.fft: Increases the amount of EXP earned in battle.

abilities.name: Accrue EXP
abilities.description: Gain 5 experience per character level at the start of each of your turns in a fight.
abilities.fft: Grants EXP upon moving.

abilities.name: Accrue JP
abilities.description: Gain 10 JP for your job at the start of each of your turns in a fight.
abilities.fft: Grants JP and Job EXP upon moving.

abilities.name: Seraph Song
abilities.description: Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you get back a level 1 spell slot (once each per song). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Restores MP to all allies each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Life's Anthem
abilities.description: Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you regain 1d4 hit points at the start of each of their turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Restores HP to all allies each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Rousing Melody
abilities.description: Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you get +3 m movement.
abilities.fft: Raises the speed of all allies each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Battle Chant
abilities.description: Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you get +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage.
abilities.fft: Raises the physical attack of all allies each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Magickal Refrain
abilities.description: Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you get +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
abilities.fft: Raises the magick attack of all allies each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Nameless Song
abilities.description: Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you are Blessed (+1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws).
abilities.fft: Grants one of several beneficial statuses to all allies each turn.

abilities.name: Finale
abilities.description: The ultimate song: allies within 9 m of you get an extra action on their next turn (Quick). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Allies' next turns come immediately.

abilities.name: Magick Surge
abilities.description: When you take damage, you get +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC for 10 turns.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving damage, raises magick attack for the battle.

abilities.name: Faith Surge
abilities.description: When a spell damages you, you gain Faith for 3 turns (+2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, -2 to saving throws).
abilities.fft: Upon receiving magick, raises faith for the battle.

abilities.name: Movement +3
abilities.description: +4.5 m movement.
abilities.fft: Movement +3.

abilities.name: Fly
abilities.description: Gives the Fly action: fly to a spot up to 18 m away; it uses half that distance of movement.
abilities.fft: Move by flying over enemies and obstacles.

abilities.name: Witch Hunt
abilities.description: Dance for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): enemies within 9 m of you get -2 to spell save DC and spell attack rolls (FFT drains MP).
abilities.fft: Reduces the MP of all foes each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Mincing Minuet
abilities.description: Dance for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): enemies within 9 m of you take 1d4 psychic damage at the start of each of their turns.
abilities.fft: Damages all foes each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Slow Dance
abilities.description: Dance for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): enemies within 9 m of you have 3 m less movement.
abilities.fft: Lowers the speed of all foes each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Polka
abilities.description: Dance for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): enemies within 9 m of you deal 2 less damage.
abilities.fft: Lowers the physical attack of all foes each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Heathen Frolic
abilities.description: Dance for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): enemies within 9 m of you have disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
abilities.fft: Lowers the magick attack of all foes each turn of the performance.

abilities.name: Forbidden Dance
abilities.description: Dance for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): enemies within 9 m of you have, at the start of each of their turns, a 1 in 10 chance each of being Blinded, Silenced, Poisoned or Slowed for 1 turn.
abilities.fft: Inflicts one of several ailments on all foes each turn.

abilities.name: Last Waltz
abilities.description: The ultimate dance: enemies within 9 m of you make a Wisdom save or lose their actions and bonus actions next turn (Disable). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Reduces all foes' CT to zero.

abilities.name: Strength Surge
abilities.description: When you take damage, you deal +2 damage with weapon attacks for 10 turns.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving damage, raises physical attack for the battle.

abilities.name: Bravery Surge
abilities.description: When a weapon attack hits you, you get +1 to attack rolls for 10 turns.
abilities.fft: Upon receiving a physical attack, raises bravery for the battle.

abilities.name: Jump +3
abilities.description: Jump 4.5 m farther.
abilities.fft: Jump +3.

abilities.name: Fly
abilities.description: Gives the Fly action: fly to a spot up to 18 m away; it uses half that distance of movement.
abilities.fft: Move by flying over enemies and obstacles.

abilities.name: Sanguine Sword
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that heals you for half the damage it deals.
abilities.fft: Absorbs the target's HP.

abilities.name: Infernal Strike
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack; on a hit the target has -2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC for 2 turns and you regain a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Absorbs the target's MP.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that adds 1d8 necrotic damage; on a hit the target makes a Constitution save or is Stopped for 1 turn (bosses are immune). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Inflict damage with a sinister sword; adds Stop.

abilities.name: Abyssal Blade
abilities.description: Costs a tenth of your maximum hit points (never your last one). Everyone else within 4.5 m of you, allies too, takes 3d8 necrotic damage, 6d8 if right next to you (Dexterity save for half). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Sacrifice own HP to deal damage to others, with the nearest units suffering the most damage.

abilities.name: Unholy Sacrifice
abilities.description: Costs a quarter of your maximum hit points (never your last one). Everyone else within 5 m of you, allies too, takes 8d8 necrotic damage and is Slowed for 2 turns (Constitution save for half damage and no Slow). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Sacrifice own HP to deal extensive dark damage to all units around you; adds Slow.

abilities.name: HP Boost
abilities.description: +20% maximum hit points.
abilities.fft: Raises maximum HP by 20 percent.

abilities.name: Vehemence
abilities.description: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, but you have -2 AC.
abilities.fft: Raises attack power by 50 percent and lowers defense by 50 percent.

abilities.name: Movement +3
abilities.description: +4.5 m movement.
abilities.fft: Move +3.

abilities.name: Jump +3
abilities.description: Jump 4.5 m farther.
abilities.fft: Jump +3.

leftOut.name: Holy Water
leftOut.why: Undead/zombie status does not exist in BG3.

leftOut.name: Safeguard
leftOut.why: Protects equipment from breaking/theft; nothing breaks equipment in BG3.

leftOut.name: Reequip
leftOut.why: Equipment changes work differently in BG3.
